# ANALYSIS: Baseline Engine Stage-1 Backtest and OOS Validation

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running a full Stage-1 backtest on the current engine (baseline) over the 16-month SPY 5m dataset will provide the edge_capture and Sharpe needed to evaluate candidate strategies against OP-16 anchors. Walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will confirm robustness.

## Mechanism

We will invoke the autoresearch grinder harness to execute a Stage-1 backtest of the baseline engine (no candidate modifications) on the full 16-month SPY 5m dataset. The grinder will produce equity curves, trade logs, and summary statistics. From these we will compute edge_capture as defined in OP-16 (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers)). We will also compute aggregate Sharpe ratio over the entire period. Subsequently, we will perform walk-forward out-of-sample analysis (e.g., 80/20 split) and real-fills validation on the three J anchor days using cached OPRA data to simulate realistic slippage and fill quality. Results will be recorded.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline engine uses qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Full 16-month SPY 5m dataset (approx 345 trading days). Selection method: all available data. Overfit risk: Stage-1 backtest is in-sample; walk-forward OOS will mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large adverse move exceeding premium stop; max drawdown unknown; blow-up scenario if multiple consecutive losers exceed daily loss limit.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until backtest completed; will disclose top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all relevant unit tests must pass.  
- Walk-forward OOS: Sharpe ratio >= 0.70 and positive edge_capture.  
- Real-fills validation: P&L on top 3 J days within ±20% of BS-sim estimate.  
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture must not decrease relative to known baseline (to be established).

5 / 10 -- pending actual backtest results; confidence will increase after OOS and real-fills validation.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis provides the baseline edge_capture and Sharpe against which all candidates in the leaderboard are measured. It does not conflict; it is the reference for OP-16 scoring. Candidates are ranked by final_score = edge_capture * aggregate_sharpe relative to this baseline.
